body: Bisnow reported on Nov. 19, 2026 that the loan on Banyan Street Capital's 191 Peachtree Tower in Atlanta has entered special servicing after the borrower said it could not pay off the balance at maturity. The report says Rialto Capital took over the $175.5M loan the month before, which is October 2026. The article gives no day for the transfer, so this entry is dated to the Bisnow report, Nov. 19, 2026, and not to the transfer itself. Bisnow cited Morningstar Analytics for the stated reason, "imminent monetary default."

Bisnow reports that Banyan purchased the 50-story, 1.2M SF tower in 2016 for $268M and that, according to Morningstar Credit, Morgan Stanley originated the $175.5M loan for the building at 3.73% in 2016. Bisnow also reports that the property's Fulton County appraised value was $194.7M this year, down from $231M in 2023.
Banyan did not respond to a request for comment, according to Bisnow.

timeline.label: Banyan purchased the tower for $268M and the $175.5M loan was originated, per Bisnow
Rialto Capital took over the $175.5M loan (day not stated; Bisnow wrote "last month")
Bisnow reported the loan had entered special servicing after the borrower said it could not pay off the balance at maturity
